narrative.integration: Integrate via the existing open PR #1: merge the single test-only commit 036c6d5 from sc-lab/gifter-escrow/patch-4-2026111517-1 into lab main. Because the change touches only contract/tests/refund-negative.ts, integration requires no program rebuild for production, no manifest, workflow, Anchor.toml or toolchain edits, no state migration and no deployed-program update; the fixture runs locally with anchor test on solana-test-validator (fixture gifter-escrow-localnet). A reviewer's checklist: the three negative cases assert ConstraintRaw then AccountNotInitialized then AccountNotInitialized in order, the positive case asserts vault and state close and the balance restores, and the final case runs only after the vault is confirmed closed. Merge decision and acceptance belong to the project's authorised humans; validation status for the head SHA comes only from the cited candidate-validation workflow run, not from this draft.
limitations: Narrative drafted by the Sol.College CTO agent; authoritative fields (commits, evidence, hashes) are assembled by code.
narrative.problem: The problem solved: the lab fixture had no refund negative-case coverage - nothing asserted that refund refuses a non-maker signer, a mismatched escrow PDA, or a second attempt after the vault is closed, nor that the happy path really closes vault and state. Candidate 036c6d5 answers that with one new test file, contract/tests/refund-negative.ts (145 added lines, 0 deletions) on parent fb2bbfd: three negative refund cases expecting ConstraintRaw, AccountNotInitialized and AccountNotInitialized, plus the positive maker refund asserting vault and state close and the maker's token balance is restored. It is test-only - no program source, workflow, manifest or toolchain file is touched.
risks: Whether the candidate-validation run (evidence id validation-run, workflow 43744241991) succeeded on head SHA 036c6d5d6955c1345aa1f2bc2019054a479e2824 is not stated by this draft; validation status comes only from that GitHub workflow evidence.

Risk: the expected error codes assume the maker-equality constraint and PDA handling exactly as they stand at lab head fb2bbfd; if the constraint implementation differs, the negative assertions may not produce ConstraintRaw or AccountNotInitialized, and the fixture result is unknown until the run is observed.

narrative.rollback: Rollback is a plain git revert of commit 036c6d5 (equivalently, deleting contract/tests/refund-negative.ts), which restores the test suite exactly to the parent state at fb2bbfd. Because the adoption is test-only, rollback needs no program redeploy, no account or funds handling, no data migration and no configuration change; existing escrows and the deployed devnet program are untouched by both the adoption and its reversal. If the fixture was already run locally, it leaves no persistent chain state beyond disposable localnet accounts. If the candidate was never merged (its current state per PR #1), rollback simply means closing PR #1 without merging, leaving main unchanged.
